subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: When a consumer requests the state of a set of proposals, the state reader shall return, per proposal: landing state (open · landed · closed-unlanded), per-required-check state, and the comments newer than the caller's cursor across the medium's proposal-discussion surfaces (discussion comments and review comments, review summaries included).
rationale: the eyes; no port can answer this today (§2.4)
fit_criterion: on both adapters, a mixed 50-proposal fixture returns all three kinds matching the medium's ground truth per enumerated surface; unknown fields are typed, never empty-string
